idea-plugin.name: Kokedera Icons - Moss Temple Icons
idea-plugin.description:
Kokedera Icons

A moss-temple file icon theme — flat, organic shapes in moss, stone, and lantern light. Designed to pair with the Kokedera color theme. Every icon draws from the same palette of moss greens, lantern ambers, and stone grays.

  • File & folder icons covering languages, frameworks, configs, DevOps, docs, and media
  • Named folder icons (src, lib, tests, components, api, database, docker, and more)
  • Hundreds of file name & extension mappings — from .rs to .prisma to kustomization.yaml
